contract: records where libass's SIMD bitmap engines depart from the gated C engine: the cases of raster-glyphs, raster-outlines and raster-bitmaps, with the pins of the C engine (pin_operation raster-) and the reference run on the host's own engine (raster-simd-); a case whose reference fold differs from its pin is one where the host's engine departs, such as \be passes over whole rows on coverage at a bitmap's right edge; the candidate computes what the C engine does

one font file read from memory: glyph ids spread evenly over face 0, loaded as libass 0.17.5 loads them with hinting off (ASS_HINTING_NONE): GDI face metrics, a REAL_DIM size request of the case's 26.6 pixel height and unhinted outlines (FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING), from FreeType 2.15.0 in the reference and triergon-font in the candidate; the cases of the arguments over those glyphs, with transforms of moderate reach (rotations within 60 degrees, matrices near the target size)

one case file read from memory, one case per line, generated from a seed: random outlines with valid, degenerate, malformed and out-of-range points and contours, each converted, rotated, stroked, transformed and rasterised, the small ones also drawn in runs, with transforms of moderate reach (rotations within 60 degrees, matrices near the target size)

one case file read from memory, one case per line, generated from a seed: sets of random bitmaps, each blurred (a tenth with variances and \be passes beyond libass's \blur and \be clamps), added, multiplied, multiplied by its inverse, subtracted, shifted and clipped

every case performed with libass 0.17.5's own stages, as the pinned build compiles them, with the bitmap engine ass_renderer_init chooses for the host (NEON on AArch64, AVX2, SSSE3 or SSE2 on x86; the C engine where libass has no assembly): ass_outline_convert, ass_outline_rotate_90, ass_outline_stroke, ass_outline_transform_2d and _3d, ass_outline_to_bitmap; a run through get_bitmap_glyph per glyph (the 3D glyph transform and its quantisation against the run, the stroked border or opaque box, the \kf karaoke leftmost x) and ass_composite_construct (blur, \be, the fill taken out of the border, the shifted shadow); ass_synth_blur, the engine's add, mul and imul blends, ass_fix_outline, ass_shift_bitmap and render_glyph's rectangle clipping with the karaoke split

per case: its status, then every outline's point and segment counts and FNV-1a hash and every bitmap's position, size and the FNV-1a hash of its rows, the run's glyph positions and the clip parts; packets count cases and bytes the outline points and bitmap pixels recorded

a case outside the grammar is recorded as unparsed, and a case the candidate refuses where libass draws is recorded with a status of its own, one for a policy limit (one frame's work, or the crate's size limits) and one for the storage budget, so the case fails; the file is read, the glyphs loaded and the cases parsed before each timed and memory operation, and the reference's renderer is created once, outside it
pending_module_requirements: matching libass's SIMD bitmap engines where they depart from its C engine (NEON blurs \be over whole 16-byte rows, into the row padding; AVX2 pads rows to 32 bytes): the C engine is the gated reference on every host, and the SIMD engines are recorded on demand (cargo xtask raster compare --diagnostic)
